description: Read the live order book for one pair right now: the top levels on both sides as [price, quantity] pairs, when it was read (observedAtMs), whether the book is synced or crossed, and level counts. levels is 1 to 200, default 20. Charged 2 rows per level returned. Live order book reads need the Max or Ultra plan and are charged against the monthly row quota.
